metadata.Paper Title: A Multilingual Task-Oriented Dialogue Dataset with Human Post-Editing
metadata.Abstract: This paper introduces a new multilingual task-oriented dialogue dataset, created by translating an existing Chinese dataset into French, Hindi, and Korean. The translation process involved using large pre-trained models followed by human post-editing to ensure accuracy and fluency. The paper details the data collection process, provides an in-depth error analysis for each target language, and establishes baseline performance using state-of-the-art sequence-to-sequence models. The dataset covers multiple dialogue subtasks, including dialogue state tracking, API call prediction, and response generation.
